carpet.rule.mineableEndPortalFrame.name: Mineable End Portal Frame
carpet.rule.mineableEndPortalFrame.desc: Makes End Portal Frame blocks mineable
carpet.rule.mineableEndPortalFrame.extra: When enabled, End Portal Frame blocks can be mined in survival mode
Hardness is set to 50.0 (same as obsidian, requires diamond/netherite pickaxe)
carpet.rule.disableWindChargeEffect.name: Disable Wind Charge Effect
carpet.rule.disableWindChargeEffect.desc: Prevents wind charges from changing block states
carpet.rule.channelingIgnoreConditions.d: Allows ignoring conditions for trident channeling
carpet.rule.channelingIgnoreConditions.e: ignore_weather_and_sky: ignores weather and sky access conditions
carpet.rule.forceOpenContainer.name: Force Open Container
carpet.rule.forceOpenContainer.extra.1: shulker_box: can open blocked shulker boxes
carpet.rule.forceOpenContainer.extra.2: any: can open any blocked container
carpet.rule.truePeacefulMode.name: True Peaceful Mode
carpet.rule.truePeacefulMode.desc: Mobs will not become hostile towards players
carpet.rule.playerCommandCloseScreen.des: Enables /player esc subcommand to close a player's screen
